units.name: RevealStagePair

units.name: BlankStageRows

units.name: BlankStagePair

units.name: QueueBrickPair
units.summary: hBrickRow/Column -> tile selected by two four-pixel cells: occupancy 1/2/3 selects definition field 0/1/2. Empty is $ff; lower nonzero ID wins. Queue at $9821+floor(row/2)*32+column and again 14 tiles right for 112-pixel horizontal wrap.

units.name: ReadBrickPairLower
units.summary: Read lower cell and set occupancy bit 1.

units.name: SelectBrickPairTile
units.summary: Choose empty tile or record field by occupancy.

units.name: EmitBrickPairCommands
units.summary: Emit two single-tile commands fourteen columns apart.

units.name: QueueBrickTileRow
units.summary: Build a 28-tile literal row command from 14 paired-cell columns. Repeat the first 14 tiles horizontally for wrap, append zero sentinel and mark pending.

units.name: BuildBrickTileColumn
units.summary: Combine upper/lower logical cells into one tile column.

units.name: ReadTileRowLower
units.summary: Read lower half-cell.

units.name: SelectTileRowTile

units.name: WriteRepeatedTileColumn

units.name: AdvanceScrollingRows
units.summary: Tick twenty row timers at CA28. On expiry use pattern CA14 bit 7 for +/- direction, offset CA00 modulo 112, then reload low-seven-bit period. Zero pattern never moves.

units.name: AdvanceScrollingRow
units.summary: Decrement timer; at expiry update offset and reload pattern period.

units.name: StoreRowCountdown

units.name: IncrementRowScrollOffset

units.name: StoreIncrementedRowOffset

units.name: DecrementRowScrollOffset

units.name: StoreDecrementedRowOffset
units.summary: Store decremented/wrapped offset.

units.name: ResetScanlineScroll

units.name: ClearScrollOffsetsLoop

units.name: StoreBorderScrollY

units.name: DiscardBottomAdvanceCell

units.name: CheckBallVerticalBounds
units.summary: Ceiling below $18; loss at/after $a0; otherwise side-wall check.

units.name: ReflectCeilingImpact

units.name: CheckBallHorizontalBounds
units.summary: Side-wall limits $10 and $7c.

units.name: BallSideWallImpact
units.summary: Reflect X and request wall audio.

units.name: CheckBrickPlayfield

units.name: ProbeBothBallAxes

units.name: ProbeDownwardBall
units.summary: Test bottom leading edge then top trailing edge at previous X. Leading hit reflects Y; trailing hit jumps to empty return at $0ecd.

units.name: ProbeUpwardBall
units.summary: Test top leading edge then bottom trailing edge at previous X. Leading hit reflects Y; trailing hit uses the same empty return.

units.name: ProbeRightwardBall

units.name: ProbeLeftwardBall
units.summary: Test left leading edge then right trailing edge at previous Y. Leading hit reflects X; trailing hit aligns X without negating velocity.

units.name: ProbeBrickCollision
units.summary: Convert OAM sample to logical row using SCY and 4-pixel height; reject row>=60/overflow. Add that display row SCX, wrap X modulo 112, divide by eight and locate cell/HP. Row-offset lookup assumes relevant cells stay inside twenty display bands.

units.name: NoBrickCollision

units.name: FindScrolledBrickColumn

units.name: FindBrickCellAndHp

units.name: FinishDestroyedBrick

units.name: ReportReflectingCollision

units.name: BeginBonusAward

units.name: TransferBonusPoints

units.name: TransferOneBonusPoint
